instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a bright, minimalist indoor room, the bald elderly man (R2) in a blue sweater and the elderly woman with short white hair (R1) in a beige sweater are locked in a warm embrace. Positioned on the left, the bald elderly man (R2) faces right, wrapping his arms tightly around her. On the right, the elderly woman (R1) faces left, resting her head against his shoulder with a joyful, smiling expression. Their arms are wrapped around each other in a tight, affectionate hug. The background is softly blurred with a neutral wall and a small table. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural indoor light, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere.
